parrafo.es: Swedish, tejido profundo, drenaje linfatico, colonicos e hidroterapia. Un equipo que se toma el tiempo de escucharte antes de cada sesion.
parrafo.en: Swedish, deep tissue, lymphatic drainage, colon hydrotherapy and more. A team that takes the time to listen before every session.

parrafo_1.es: MedLife Massage es un spa de bienestar en North Miami fundado por Hans Stephen. El equipo incluye terapeutas como Nykia, Yoanis, Yuri, Marie y Luis, cada uno enfocado en que la sesion se adapte a lo que tu cuerpo necesita ese dia.
parrafo_1.en: MedLife Massage is a wellness spa in North Miami founded by Hans Stephen. The team includes therapists like Nykia, Yoanis, Yuri, Marie and Luis, each focused on tailoring the session to what your body needs that day.

parrafo_2.es: Mas alla del masaje clasico, ofrecemos drenaje linfatico, hidroterapia de colon y tratamientos de piel, todo en un espacio pensado para desconectar del ritmo de Miami.
parrafo_2.en: Beyond classic massage, we offer manual lymphatic drainage, colon hydrotherapy and skin treatments, all in a space built to help you disconnect from the pace of Miami.

texto.es: Eliges el paquete o la terapia en nuestro sistema de citas, sin llamadas ni esperas.
texto.en: Pick your package or therapy in our booking system, no calls, no waiting.

texto.es: Nos cuentas que te molesta o que buscas, para ajustar presion y enfoque de la sesion.
texto.en: Tell us what is bothering you or what you are after, so we can adjust pressure and focus.

texto.es: Desde un Swedish de 60 minutos hasta un combo de colonico y masaje: tu terapeuta se toma el tiempo necesario.
texto.en: From a 60-minute Swedish to a colon hydrotherapy and massage combo: your therapist takes the time it needs.

texto.es: Recomendaciones simples para sostener el alivio y, si quieres, tu proximo paquete ya agendado.
texto.en: Simple recommendations to keep the relief going and, if you want, your next package already booked.

nota.es: Precios de paquetes combinados. Tambien ofrecemos sesiones individuales: escribenos para el detalle completo.
nota.en: Prices shown are for combo packages. Single sessions are also available, message us for the full menu.

texto.es: Masaje deportivo de 60 minutos mas estiramiento de cuerpo completo.
texto.en: A 60-minute sports massage plus a full-body stretch session.

pie.es: Tambien: drenaje linfatico, masaje prenatal, reflexologia y tratamientos de piel. Escribenos por el menu completo.
pie.en: Also available: lymphatic drainage, prenatal massage, reflexology and skin treatments. Message us for the full menu.

items.quote: I had an AMAZING experience here from Nykia & Yoanis. I received my first ever two Angel of water treatments, a lymphatic drainage massage from Yoannis, and a complimentary ionic foot detox while they accommodated my schedule.

I had such a great experience with my facial! It was definitely worth the money, and my girl really put in the work. You could tell she genuinely cared about my skin, and I left feeling so refreshed and relaxed.
I have been having some gastro issues, specially after going out the country, so I decided to book a colonic hydrotherapy. The office was clean and the staff greeted me warmly.
